narratives.Description: bug(doctor): #4162 escaping-symlink test EPERMs on Windows without Developer Mode
narratives.Overview:
## Problem
Release `v0.115.0` Phase 4 Step 5 (`task check` / `verify:ac`) fails closed on Windows. `#4162` added `containDepositInstallRoot rejects an escaping symlink` in `packages/core/src/doctor/branches.test.ts`. `symlinkSync` throws `EPERM` unless Developer Mode / admin is on. The test has no platform skip.

This is the first cut that includes that test (not present at v0.114.0). Linux CI TypeScript is green; this host cannot create the symlink.

`verify:ac` also targeted the just-completed leftover `#4162` brief (`#3357`) with `pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/doctor packages/core/src/migrate-preflight`.

## Recurrence
Any Windows `task check` / release Step 5 after `#4162` lands.

## Acceptance
- The escaping-symlink case still runs on platforms that can create the symlink.
- On Windows without symlink privilege, the test skips or uses a non-EPERM fixture. It must not fail `task check`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/doctor packages/core/src/migrate-preflight` exits 0 on this Windows checkout.

## Release
v0.115.0 cut paused at Step 5. Do not `--skip-ci` as first recovery (#2859).
